promises.quote: Devices have been retro- fitted to the doors on all Ford Transit vehicles, the type of vehicle the accident occurred on. This blocks the gaps between the back of the vehicle and the handrail.
promises.summary: Retrofit safety devices to block gaps between vehicle back and handrail

promises.quote: newly redesigned Client Transport Referral Form has also been devised by the Transport Operations Group, in conjunction with Adult Services. promises.quote: A system has been produced and this will be implemented by 14 July 2014, to ensure that any information provided verbally by Day Centre staff to vehicle staff on arrival regarding the client is also provided in a written format. The written form includes guidance notes for staff with regard to what type of information must be relayed.
promises.summary: Implement written information system for day centre staff to vehicle staff communication
